evidence: backend/servers/reality-server/src/main.rs:453 — production wiring constructs the saved-search alert drainer via `SearchAlertDrainerWorker::new(db, SearchAlertDrainerConfig::from_env())`, which (search_alert_drainer.rs:188-195) hard-codes the logging stubs `LogEmailTransport` / `LogPushTransport` as the email + push transports. There is no `with_transports(...)` call with a real SMTP/FCM/APNs adapter anywhere outside tests (only ref besides the def is main.rs:453).

Both stub transports unconditionally return `Ok(())` (search_alert_drainer.rs:81-94 send_email, :100-119 send_push — they only `tracing::info!` what *would* be sent). In `run_once()` (search_alert_drainer.rs:280-325) an alert is treated as delivered when `any_ok` is true, and the email stub alone always sets `any_ok = true`, so EVERY drained alert reaches `self.repo.mark_search_alert_notified(alert.id)` (:318) and its `notified_at` watermark is set.

Net effect in production: saved-search alert emails and push notifications are silently NEVER sent, yet the drainer marks each queue row delivered (notified_at set, independent of the in-app read `status`). Because the row is stamped delivered, it is filtered out by `list_undelivered_search_alerts` on the next poll — the miss is undetectable from the queue and users who configured saved-search alerts (a shipped Epic 16 feature) receive nothing. Documented as an intended 'first cut' (module doc lines 16-22) but the stub is wired into `main.rs` and drains+consumes real queue rows in prod, so the feature is effectively dead while reporting success. Fix: guard the drainer behind real transports (or keep SEARCH_ALERT_DRAINER_ENABLED=false in prod until an adapter exists) so it does not consume/mark-delivered rows it cannot actually deliver.

backend/servers/reality-server/src/services/search_alert_drainer.rs:259-276 — the alert `subject` and `body` are built from hard-coded English `format!` templates ('N new listings match your saved search ...', 'Open the app to view them.') with English-only pluralization ('listing'/'listings', 'it'/'them'). The 4-locale reality portal (sk/cs/de/en) therefore sends every saved-search alert email + push in English regardless of recipient locale.

The `AlertNotification.locale` field (search_alert_drainer.rs:45-47) is explicitly resolved from `alert.recipient_locale` (:272-275, defaulting to 'en') and threaded to the transport traits, but is never used to localize the composed copy — the copy is built in English BEFORE the transport is called, so even a future locale-aware transport cannot fix it (localization seam is on the wrong side of the composition).

The same crate already has the correct pattern: services/email.rs:102-111 localizes the password-reset email via `reset_subject(locale)` / `reset_body(name, url, locale)` with a `match locale { sk|cs|de|en }`. The saved-search alert drainer bypasses this established per-`Locale` pattern. Fix: compose subject/body per `notification.locale` (mirror email.rs reset_subject/reset_body), or move localization into the transport and pass structured data instead of pre-rendered English.
